stakeholders.name: Student organization officer
stakeholders.concern: A fast answer, and clear reasons when the answer is no.
questions: How do you ask for a venue today, and what makes it slow?
What information do you usually forget to include in a request?
What would you like to see in the answer when your request is returned?

stakeholders.name: Student Affairs officer
stakeholders.concern: Fair, consistent decisions with a record of why.
questions: Which checks do you do by hand before you approve an event?
When do you override a rule, and how do you record the reason?
Which requests take you the longest to decide, and why?

stakeholders.name: Facilities staff
stakeholders.concern: No double bookings and no damaged rooms left unpaid.
questions: How do you record a reservation, and who else can see it?
What happens when two organizations ask for the same room?
How do you handle a venue with an unpaid penalty?

stakeholders.name: Finance clerk
stakeholders.concern: Deposits are paid before the event, and sponsor money is recorded in pesos.
questions: How do you know that a deposit is paid?
How are sponsor amounts in other currencies recorded today?
Which part of the payment record is wrong most often?

stakeholders.name: IT administrator
stakeholders.concern: Few moving parts, clear logs, and no secrets in the code.
questions: Which systems can we call, and in which format do they answer?
What happens to the campus network when an outside service is down?
How should we record who asked for what, and when?
